## 同尺度母图

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a FIVE-TIER compact GAME ENERGY FACILITY SAME-SCALE MASTER. Input image is STYLE AND SIMPLIFICATION reference of machining v2 only, do NOT copy machining tools. Layout 3 cells upper row and 2 centered lower row, five different generators, same front-right elevated camera, equal pixel base width and comparable overall height. All generators same physical envelope: SQUARE base 1.2m x 1.2m, total height 1.3m including exhaust/cooling details. One identical low square plinth with four corner bolts per generator. Body fills square depth, no thin front facade. Match reference low-poly chunky matte surfaces, visibly faceted bevels, 5-8 bold major forms, simple flat panel areas, very sparse bolts and pipes, clean warm beige background soft shadows, full objects with margins. No text captions, watermark, people. Shared gameplay feature on ALL FIVE: exactly ONE SMALL black rectangular RECESSED resource opening in LOWER-RIGHT FRONT decorative panel, thin rectangular frame and four corner bolts, approx 15% body width, SAME geometry/relative position, vary texture only. Flush, no duct, hopper, tray, door canopy, outboard pipe. Every other component stays within square plan. Technology advances through energy mechanism/integration, NOT size or mounting more tiny accessories. TOP LEFT T1 scrap wood gasifier: squat rusty drum back-left with very short chimney, front-left visible single chunky flywheel and belt connecting simple engine block, one curved pipe, small analog gauge, rough olive brackets. Compact few salvage forms, starter primitive, no multiple cylinders or rat's nest wires, no glow. TOP CENTRE T2 diesel/biogas generator: compact olive/yellow square-plan steel cabinet, ONE large front cooling fan left, one small upper-right analog meter, short bent exhaust behind, simple side grille, practical motor equipment no sci-fi. TOP RIGHT T3 solid hydrogen storage: simple silver-white/black square-plan cabinet, THREE broad stacked cartridge drawers at front-left, tiny icy-blue indicator bars and one small frosted side cooling line; no giant glowing chamber. Upper-right front bold cyan two-connected-atoms icon with legible 'H₂', small LCD. LOWER LEFT T4 cold fusion: coherent compact titanium/white ceramic square-plan BLOCK, roof has ONE inset copper segmented toroidal magnetic ring with small restrained BLUE luminous inner ring (no big sphere); front has one small dark inspection pane, side one ribbed heat exchanger, one simple coolant loop. Front-upper-right badge is cyan containment circle enclosing two inward-pointing chevrons and copper dot. No tripod, no huge orb glued onto box, no detailed plumbing. LOWER RIGHT T5 ultimate hot fusion: compact matte graphite square-plan armored block, restrained gold trim, ONE small white-gold solar viewport front-left, exactly THREE short thick ribbed cooling caps on back roof not towering chimneys, simple corner armor supports, no robotic arm. Bold front-upper-right golden sun disc with eight rays and white centre. Most refined integrated powerful silhouette, not larger than other units. Preserve distinct tier identification and identical shared intake, square bases and scale.
